changelog: **Two MARKETING operator CLIs (#2959):** `prisma/apply-marketing-stage-preset.mjs --org <slug|id> [--apply]` brings an existing MARKETING tenant's stage set to the current `MARKETING_FUNNEL` preset — every preset stage upserted, a retired key deleted only when no record sits on it and no `StageSla` names it (otherwise the whole run is refused and nothing is written), the preset's service levels written the way `PUT /api/admin/stage-sla` writes them, all in one transaction with a before/after diff. `prisma/wipe-integration-source.mjs --org <slug|id> --source <slug> [--apply]` rolls one integration source back: the accounts it created, with their funnel records, history, lead stand-ins, activity entries and the source's events, one transaction per account, with the verdict re-read inside it; an account a person worked on is kept and named — any row in a table pointing at its records or the account (bar an argued list of machine-only tables), a person's activity entry, a typed deal value, contact-permission evidence, or a lead that is not its own stand-in — and accounts the source only moved keep their events and activity entries as evidence; other sources and other organizations are never touched. The stage-preset run locks the rows on the keys it retires before deleting them. Both are dry runs by default (`--json` prints a machine-readable plan). What a source created is now recorded on the new nullable `Company.createdBySource`, stamped by the account-event writer in the same insert (unset for every other way an account is created, and for accounts ingested before this change). Plain-ESM mirrors of the preset, its service levels, the apply refusals and the lead stand-in constants are compared with the TypeScript originals in `scripts/test/marketing-ops-clis.test.mjs`.
